patterns.note: A consistent dark mode theme is used throughout, with content centered on a very dark background and ample vertical spacing between sections.
Large, bold sans-serif headings establish a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
A high-contrast palette features white text on a deep charcoal background, with a vibrant purple used for primary calls-to-action and key accents.
The navigation bar at the top of the page becomes sticky after initial scroll, and subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Feature sections are introduced with prominent, centered headings and often use a two-column layout to pair descriptive text with illustrative UI screenshots or conceptual diagrams.

technique_notes: The site employs a deep, consistent dark mode by setting a very dark background color across all sections and using light-colored text for high readability.
A sticky header is implemented, allowing the main navigation to remain accessible as the user scrolls down the page.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to progressively reveal content sections, typically with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong focal points, with clear differentiation for subheadings and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and UI elements within the embedded screenshots.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks, especially in the hero area.

standout: The site's distinctive deep dark mode aesthetic, combined with the seamless integration of detailed, high-fidelity UI mockups and conceptual diagrams, effectively communicates the product's sophisticated capabilities. The visual language around knowledge graphs and canvas features is particularly unique.
